[[Dabineh Deathbringer]] is a [[Ntouka]] [[boss]] that can be found on the eastern side of the [[Sunward Marches]].

==Locations==
* [[Kourna]]
** {{NPC location|Sunward Marches}}

==Skills==
* {{skill icon|Balthazar's Rage}}
* {{skill icon|Chilling Victory}}
* {{skill icon|Intimidating Aura}}
* {{skill icon|Reap Impurities}}
* {{skill icon|Reaper's Sweep}} ([[elite]])

==Items dropped==
* [[Half-Digested Armor]]
* [[The Deathbringer]] ([[unique]])
* [[Scroll of Rampager's Insight]]

==Notes==
* It is easier to reach this boss travelling south from [[Venta Cemetery]]. Travelling north from the [[Command Post]] you will come across [[Mandragor]] [[spawn]]s.
* This boss may not spawn while you have [[Building the Base: Prisoners of War]] active.
* Consider bringing another [[Signet of Capture]] to get [[Avatar of Lyssa]] from the [[Acolyte of Lyssa|nearby]] boss.
